fix.rationale: wJoyIgnore ($D730) bit 5 is the authoritative Gen 1 engine flag for 'being used for text/menu'. The old condition used (text_box != 0 OR joy_ignore & 0x20), but wTextBoxID (0xD125) retains stale values after warp/dialog-end. Now only joy_ignore bit 5 is used.
fix.commit_message: fix: generalize stale-dialog detection for all maps using wJoyIgnore bit 5
